notes: CBER CGMP/data-integrity letter for a licensed biologics manufacturer (Thymoglobulin and Altuviiio): quality-unit failures, incomplete/untraceable laboratory and environmental-monitoring records, uncontrolled review checklists, and deviations cancelled without investigation (including an unresolved 'orange material' filling-residue finding). is_sterile_product is marked true as an inference (injectable biologics manufactured with air/particulate monitoring) though the letter never uses the words 'sterile' or 'aseptic'. contamination_present is false because the orange-material finding was left unresolved/inconclusive rather than confirmed as contamination. No FEI is stated in the letter.
